SELECT 
  (y2013.Consumption - y2012.Consumption) / y2012.Consumption AS ConsumptionDecreaseRate
FROM 
  yearmonth y2012
JOIN 
  yearmonth y2013 ON y2012.CustomerID = y2013.CustomerID
WHERE 
  y2012.Date = '2012-08-25' AND y2013.Date = '2013-08-25';

SELECT GasStationID, SUM(Amount * Price) AS TotalRevenue
FROM transactions_1k
GROUP BY GasStationID
ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k WHERE ProductID = (SELECT ProductID FROM products WHERE Description = 'premium') AND Country = 'SVK') * 100.0 /

SELECT p.Description, COUNT(t.TransactionID) AS SalesCount
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.Description
ORDER BY SalesCount DESC
LIMIT 5;

FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;
